title: Luckman: book's alien drawing matches a British Museum image

tellings.quote: And I've sent you the photo. I've sent you the photo out of the British Museum. It's the It's exactly the being that it was drawn by.

plain: A drawing of an alien in a 1970s book called UFOs: Past, Present and Future, made by Bob Emenegger and Allan Sandler, is said to match an old image held in the British Museum in London. The researcher Grant Cameron repeats this from a man named Michael Luckman, and says he has sent Michels the British Museum photo, which shows "exactly the being" that was drawn. If true, it would mean the book's alien was modelled on something far older.
